purpose: Bind Study C to the exact geographic-opportunity and structural-support constants already frozen for Study B. No new threshold is selected for Study C.

directed_geographic_opportunity.edge_location: midpoint of each unchanged within-species density-scaled genetic graph edge in ECEF kilometres
directed_geographic_opportunity.source_target_coverage: fraction of target graph-edge midpoints whose nearest source graph-edge midpoint is <=500 km
directed_geographic_opportunity.eligible_target: at least five eligible source species in its frozen panel role

structural_gates_before_synthetic_qualif.inheritance: Exact Study-B response-blind structural gates; not chosen from Study-C external or genetic outcomes.

taxonomic_breadth.inheritance: Exact Study-B supported source/target breadth gate, inherited without changing 0.50 / 0.05 / four-order constants.

clarification_boundary.reason: The Study-C exposure and mask contracts already required unchanged frozen geographic support but did not name a dedicated machine-readable opportunity file. This file binds that inherited contract before B formal qualification and before any B/C genetic response.

forbidden: change 500 km, 0.50 coverage, source>=5, or 50/50/1000 structural gates after Study-C external relation is observed
use Study-B qualification or empirical outcome to alter Study-C opportunity geometry
replace a failed Study-C opportunity gate with a different radius, coverage threshold, subgroup, or panel
